original.inventory_scope: All 64 @Test methods in this exact file, not all prior WP-309 tests or the historical 73-test executed suite.

candidate_tests.provenance_gate: Existing candidate fixtures save a bare channel/message then request a captured window. These are not accepted positive authority fixtures until the revised producer proves original occupant provenance AND each original reaction receive occurrence. Neither a DTO, current channel slot, window read nor matching UUID may fabricate either proof. All current ChannelReceiveEnvelope origins are reported Unproved by the live producer owners; no reaction admission is inferred from that report.

rules: Each original method occurs exactly once in the groups below. Grouping does not waive its parameter family, assertions, mounted consumer behavior or required execution.
All original tests and assertions remain unchanged. A missing interception is not a pass and must never be fixed with a timeout, skip, weakened expectation or a fake authority.
Direct paths retain their existing split persistence boundary and legacy queue semantics. Re-run them on the composed head; previous execution is not execution of this candidate.
Atomic rollback controls can replace impossible split-transaction partial states only after independent equivalence review and execution against the actual Room authority and mounted consumer.
A public authority exception does not certify rollback even when a test deliberately forces an SQLite rollback. UNKNOWN remains bound and non-redrivable without an admitted recovery journal.
No method count or source header is passing evidence. Exact candidate tests must be discovered and execute on the allowed hosted route.
Guard activation stays OFF. The unproven incoming/legacy-history provenance contract is being revised by its owners; 67a and a75 are diagnostic source, not a coherent executable composition.

Only completed Bob is acknowledged; Carol/Dave and original wire/contact/radio/receivedAt/arrival metadata survive.
Original partial-row/summary expectations, duplicate repair, UUID preservation, three-row final convergence, rendered summary and cancellation-not-error behavior stay unchanged.

Keep the two original split controls for a deliberately tested legacy seam; do not relabel them as guarded coverage.

groups.required_action: Execute actual Room trigger control and mounted failure visibility after valid occupant provenance is available. Preserve final convergence as a separate unresolved obligation; only a reviewed recovery receipt/journal could justify safe retry.

Neither is the old state of Carol committed with stale summary; that split state is intentionally impossible in the guarded operation.

additional_controls_not_substitutes_for_: Each pending native operation, protected batch item, selected MCO parked item and overflow envelope must carry its own original reaction occurrence independently of the target proof. One history replay batch may contain multiple occurrences; a batch-wide proof, later slot/queue observation or current target window cannot replace them. Unproved reactions remain bounded non-redrivable custody, never ordinary native matching or ordinary chat.
Bound/Unbound/Miss, wrong-radio, identical replacement, stale no-fallback and unproven original provenance need independent positive and negative original-input evidence.
Original corrected senderTimestamp, old pending timestamps, indexedAt collision order, history over 200 rows and default five/500 cache boundaries remain separate obligations.
Real orphan/slot replacement/restore/migration evidence belongs to the actual storage issuer; a test CacheMarker is not that issuer.
Typed overflow and process-owned App custody do not prove upstream event dispatcher, ACK, RX or polling losslessness or durable restart recovery.
